description: Conservative candidate-family leads for common job titles that do not map cleanly to one O*NET title.

entries.label: Data analyst
entries.note: The title is domain-dependent. Confirm whether the work is business intelligence, management analysis, or financial analysis.

candidates.note: Business intelligence is a possible fit when the posting centers on data systems, reporting, and analytics products.
Management analysis is a possible fit when the posting centers on organizational processes and recommendations.
Financial analysis is a possible fit when the posting centers on investment, budgets, or financial models.

entries.label: Machine learning engineer
entries.note: The title can sit between data science and software development. Confirm the occupation from the job tasks and production responsibilities.

candidates.note: Data Scientists is a possible fit when the work centers on statistical modeling, experimentation, and machine learning methods.
Software Developers is a possible fit when the work centers on production systems, software design, and deployment.

entries.label: People analytics analyst
entries.note: The title combines an HR domain with analytical work. Confirm whether the posting is primarily HR practice, business intelligence, or organizational analysis.

candidates.note: Human Resources Specialists is a possible fit when the work centers on HR programs, workforce processes, and employee data.
Business Intelligence Analysts is a possible fit when the work centers on analytical products, reporting, and data systems.
Management Analysts is a possible fit when the work centers on organizational diagnosis and recommendations.

entries.label: Product manager
entries.note: Product management is highly context-dependent. Confirm whether the posting emphasizes market positioning, operations, or another occupational family.

candidates.note: Marketing Managers is a possible fit when the work centers on market positioning, customer research, and product strategy.
General and Operations Managers is a possible fit when the work centers on cross-functional operations and business ownership.

entries.label: UX designer
entries.note: Confirm that the posting centers on user research, interaction design, and digital interface work.

candidates.note: Web and Digital Interface Designers is a possible fit for digital interface and user experience design work.

entries.label: Cybersecurity analyst
entries.note: Confirm that the posting centers on information security analysis rather than broader IT operations or software engineering.

candidates.note: Information Security Analysts is a possible fit for monitoring, assessing, and protecting information systems.

entries.label: HR business partner
entries.note: Confirm the seniority and balance between HR advisory work, workforce programs, and people management.

candidates.note: Human Resources Specialists is a possible fit for HR advisory and workforce program work.
Human Resources Managers is a possible fit when the role owns HR programs or supervises HR functions.
